title: Surreal Desert Vortex
description: A surreal desert scene features a large brown rabbit with a blue third eye emerging from a swirling brown vortex. In the red sky, a stitched bald man's head with an open mouth appears within a golden sunburst. A red octagonal sign with a blank dripping panel sits in the foreground among green thorny vines and scattered eyeballs. Three white masks with red lips and stitches float to the right.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape with red rocky ground under a bright blue sky. A giant brown rabbit with a blue third eye on its forehead emerges from a swirling brown vortex in the center. Above, a bald man's head with stitches across the forehead and an open mouth floats inside a golden sunburst halo. Three white theatrical masks with red lips and black stitches float on the right connected by golden threads. In the foreground, a red octagonal sign with a blank white rectangle covered in black drips stands among green thorny vines and scattered eyeballs. Text fragments like BEAST GARDEN and NO ENTRY appear on torn clouds.
